name: Dense trade blotter row
note: Dense multi-column blotter grid: side chip, symbol, qty, avg px, live P&L and venue. A timer retickers a random row every ~1.15s, flashing that cell green/red via keyframes and recomputing P&L plus the net footer. Every figure is tabular-nums; direction is carried by an arrow and sign, not just colour. Rows are tabbable with a visible focus ring.

name: Fills list with partial-fill progress
note: Four working orders, each with a filled/total counter and a progress track. Bars are driven by requestAnimationFrame with a cubic ease and a staggered start, so the counts literally count up in step with the bar. Unfilled bars carry a shimmer sweep; completing one swaps the bar to green and the percent to FILLED, and the header tallies how many are done. An abort token stops a superseded animation, and top-up fills flash the counter.

name: Order status timeline
note: Horizontal NEW → ACK → PART → FILL rail. A gradient fill grows along the rail as the order advances, completed dots draw a CSS checkmark, and the current dot pulses with an expanding ring. The detail bar under it swaps timestamp and message with a slide. It advances itself on a loop; clicking any step is a real button that takes over and pins that stage.

name: Execution-quality scorecard
note: TCA scorecard: an SVG ring drawn with stroke-dashoffset while the score counts from zero, beside three metric rows whose values count up and whose micro-bars grow on a stagger. Slippage and fill rate read green with ▼/▲, adverse reversion reads red with ▲, so sign carries the meaning without colour. REPLAY is a real focusable button that re-runs the whole draw.

name: Streaming audit trail
note: Immutable event log on a gradient rail: FILL / REPL / ACK / CXL badges, microsecond timestamps and actor tags. New rows are prepended every 2.3s with a slide-and-highlight keyframe, the list caps at ten and old rows drop off the bottom. Hovering or focusing the log pauses the stream and the header pill flips from STREAM to PAUSED, so a reader can actually read it. Price moves inside a replace carry ▲ with green.

name: Cancel-replace control
note: A working order you can actually amend: qty and limit steppers bump with a spring, changed fields turn accent blue and the footer shows the Δ with ▲/▼. REPLACE is disabled until something is dirty, then runs a PENDING REPL state with a sweeping shimmer before committing old→new values. Cancel is destructive so it is hold-to-confirm — an 850ms fill sweeps the button under pointer or Space/Enter hold, and releasing early aborts.

name: Order lifecycle badges
note: A live status card that morphs through the order lifecycle above a legend of all eight states. Every state pairs a colour with its own glyph (◷ ● ◑ ✓ ⇄ ✕ ⊘ ◌) and an inset colour rail, so the state survives colour-blindness and greyscale. The legend chips pop in on a stagger and are real toggle buttons with aria-pressed — clicking one stops the auto-cycle and pins that state, including its qty and reason line.
html: ◷ PENDING NEW ORD 8841-QX · sent 09:31:02.114 0 / 900

name: Grouped fills with legs
note: Parent orders collapse their executions to one line — total qty and VWAP-style average — and expand to the individual venue legs. The accordion animates measured max-height, the chevron rotates, and legs fade up on an nth-child stagger against a leg rail. One group open at a time; the first opens itself on mount so the motion is visible. Headers are real buttons carrying aria-expanded.
